rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an unwelcome bother, demand, or presence.

example.english: Having to clean up after them all the time is a real imposition.
example.traditional: 成日叫人幫佢執手尾，真係好麻煩。
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 giu3 jan4 bong1 keoi5 zap1 sau2 mei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this when the imposition is mainly a burden or obligation that someone has to carry.

example.english: Having to care for the whole family alone is a huge imposition for them.
example.traditional: 要一個人照顧成家人，對佢哋嚟講真係好大嘅負擔。
example.jyutping: jiu3 jat1 go3 jan4 ziu3 gu3 sing4 gaa1 jan4 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 ge3 fu6 daam1

rows.note: Use this for an unwelcome person or thing that drags someone down or gets in the way.

example.english: This old computer keeps crashing; having it around is an imposition.
example.traditional: 呢部舊電腦成日死機，擺喺度反而係累贅。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 seng4 jat6 sei2 gei1 baai2 hai2 dou6 faan2 ji4 hai6 leoi6 zeoi6
